needs.title: Oakridge Elementary HVAC replacement
needs.summary: Replace aging HVAC equipment. The project is named in the proposed $80M school bond (Nov 3, 2026) as part of a broader Oakridge Refresh (HVAC, roofing, flooring, painting). An energy services company's April 2026 preliminary scope describes it as a geothermal HVAC renovation with a full electrical replacement, LED lighting and an interior refresh.
needs.why_track: A whole-system HVAC replacement is a capital project: the School Board lists it in the 10-year CIP and funds it through County bonds, so it waits for the bond cycle. We found no dollar cutoff in any APS document that would move it to the faster maintenance (MC/MM) budget. APS is also weighing an energy savings performance contract (ESPC), a non-bond route the School Board asked staff to analyze in January 2026. The only records of that analysis are two 2026 decks from one energy services company, with no solicitation or contract (see the FOIA response below).

inquiries.question: What is the plan to make my children's school safe for learning over the next two months?
inquiries.response_summary: Copied the school principal, who will work closely to monitor the situation.

inquiries.to: APS FOIA Officer (Office of Division Counsel)
inquiries.question: Since July 2023, what utility rebates has APS received, what IRA elective-pay filings has it made, what state or federal facility grants has it applied for, and what did the School Board's January 2026 non-bond financing analysis produce?
inquiries.response_summary: No utility rebates and no elective-pay filings. One grant: $5.3M ARPA CSLFRF for Barcroft HVAC (applied 2021, obligated 2024). The non-bond financing analysis consists of two decks from CMTA, an energy services company: a Feb 2026 ESPC pitch and an Apr 2026 preliminary scope pricing Oakridge at $27.5M and Jamestown at $31.0M. No solicitation, letter of intent or contract was produced. Answered in six days at no charge.

inquiries.question: If Question 4 fails on Nov 3, what happens to the Oakridge Refresh, and does the HVAC replacement move to the maintenance budget?
inquiries.why: No document says. The County notes the School Board may reallocate bond funds among CIP projects, and nothing names Oakridge either way.

inquiries.question: What is the interim plan for hot classrooms between now and the summer 2027 construction start?
inquiries.why: The April 2026 email asked this for one spring. The reply named who would monitor, not what would be done.

inquiries.question: Has APS signed a letter of intent with CMTA, and would an energy savings performance contract move the Oakridge HVAC work outside the Nov 3 bond?
inquiries.why: CMTA's proposed timeline put a letter of intent on June 1, 2026 and a signed contract on Dec 11, 2026. The FOIA response produced neither, and APS did not say whether one exists.

sources.title: Initial Project Scope and Budget: Oakridge Elementary and Jamestown Elementary
sources.publisher: CMTA (a Legence company), prepared for Arlington Public Schools
sources.notes: Dated April 17, 2026; 60 pages; released under APS FOIA 26-16. Geothermal HVAC (74 wells at Oakridge, 70 at Jamestown), full electrical replacement, LED lighting, interior refresh; Jamestown adds a roof and fire protection. Construction estimates $27.5M (Oakridge) and $31.0M (Jamestown) before federal tax credits of $6.11M and $5.69M. Proposed timeline: letter of intent Jun 1, out to bid Sep 21, APS bid review Nov 2, signed contract Dec 11, 2026; construction 2027-2028.
